name: Proxima d
tagline: Le monde le plus interne de Proxima — une sous-Terre qui frôle l'étoile tous les cinq jours.

facts.label: Masse
facts.value: ≥ 0.26 Earth masses (lightest known exoplanet by RV)

facts.label: Zone
facts.value: Deep inside the habitable zone — scorched

history: Proxima d is the innermost and lightest of the red dwarf's confirmed planets — barely a quarter of Earth's mass, circling at 0.029 AU so a 'year' lasts just five days. ESPRESSO, the ultra-precise spectrograph on ESO's Very Large Telescope, teased out its whisper of a stellar wobble in 2022, making it one of the least massive planets ever found by radial velocity. Any surface is far too hot for liquid water — but its detection proves the nearest star hides a whole planetary system, not a lone world, and that our instruments can now feel planets lighter than Earth tugging a star four light-years away.
